services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: william cuneo
reviews.text: I had two vehicles towed from one location and delivered to 2 seperate locations on short notice. T&J responded to my request quickly and kept me updated throughout the process. Definitely will recommend to others.

reviews.author: Sarah B
reviews.text: I had a great experience with T & J Towing and Recovery in Hanover County. They were professional, quick to respond, and very friendly throughout the whole process. The driver showed up on time, handled my vehicle with care, and made a stressful situation much easier. Pricing was fair and everything was explained clearly. I’d definitely recommend them to anyone in the area who needs a reliable towing service.

reviews.author: jake simonds
reviews.text: We were in a bind in Virginia Beach as I was on vacation with my family. Our vehicle was illegally towed by a different tow company in Virginia Beach. A friend of mine reached out to the owner of T&J towing who then called me and helped explain towing laws and regulations of Virginia which made it easier getting our vehicle back from the other company. As a tow company owner myself from Michigan I appreciate all this company did to help us In our situation, if you are in the Richmond VA area and need towing I highly recommend giving T & J a call. Stand up company! Thanks for the help!

reviews.author: Shaun Hayes
reviews.text: Tj and jess were awesome aszisting me when i blew a steer tire out on my rollback on a friday afternoon ... im from north carolina and was not. Familiar with any tire shops so i called them them they referred my to. A place and even offered to come tow me if we needed it. Even tho i was in empria. U guys r awesome and very carinv and professional u r the best

reviews.author: Kristin Melton
reviews.text: Jessica and her husband are absolutely phenomenal! We have used them several times and the service is always top notch and very reasonably priced! I would recommend them to anyone who needs towing or recovery. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Kedejha Pryor
reviews.text: The only lady I’ve had an interaction with was beyond rude and overly disrespectful. They tell you one thing just for the police to tell you something totally different and their prices are beyond pricey for them to be open certain hours and even later on weekends. They make you schedule appointments and everything for pickup which can be an inconvenience to others when the hours are horrible. If they get rid of the wife of the company maybe they would get better reviews! Highly not recommended!!!!

reviews.author: Jessica Fletcher (Jess fletch)
reviews.text: They did a great job of getting my vehicle from point to point b quick and efficiently! Great with communication, and even parked it how I needed it! Thanks for the great service!

reviews.author: Justin Lingerfelt
reviews.text: T&J was great to us. From the tow after the accident to the appointment to clean out the car everything was timely and professional. We’re grateful for a smooth experience.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service , from the moment I called , they were professional , friendly , and reassuring . The driver arrived quickly , handled my vehicle with care , and explained everything clearly . Being stranded is stressful but they made the whole experience smooth and worry free . I highly recommend them to anyone who needs reliable and honest service !

reviews.author: Kathlyn Evans
reviews.text: Terrible-in every aspect. Refused to produce a price listing. I was charged $850/hr at two hours of a 6.2mi tow, $150 for fuel, 14 days of garaging when the vehicle was removed after 10, as well as random administrative fees. The proof is in the attached invoice. I’ve gone above and beyond to submit a formal claim with the Attorney General’s office in an effort to remove them from the local vendor list of suggested tow lots. I would strongly suggest using any other tow lot available before this one. This place is the definition of insurance gouging. Beware!

reviews.author: Shane Farmer
reviews.text: I use T & J Towing for all of my towing needs. They always get the job done efficiently and in a timely manner and at a fair price. I highly recommend T & J for your towing and Recovery needs.

reviews.author: Allison Hughes
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful, they were very responsive, affordable and friendly. They arrived ahead of scheduled pickup time. I will 100% use them again and again.

reviews.author: Becky Williams
reviews.text: Professional and fast! Thank you for picking up my son’s car. We will be keeping y’all’s number for future use.

reviews.author: Idn Tanwi
reviews.text: TJ does a fantastic job with getting ahead of our lot’s issues. Always professional and courteous! If you ever need a tow truck company that is by the book and available 24:7, 365 days a year! It’s TJ Towing.

reviews.author: Ally Keel
reviews.text: Amazing company great reliable service and very friendly workers I called and had a tow within 10 minutes max very fast and would recommend to all!!

reviews.author: Danielle Lowry
reviews.text: Amazing service! My car broke down while driving home from the hospital and they were here to help ASAP! Truly a lifesaver.

reviews.author: Brandon L
reviews.text: Jessica and Tereall were great. Friendly and informative as they could be, as I watched my totaled car get dragged onto their wrecker. Also, when I needed to get into the tow yard to clear out my car, they made it easy to get in and get what I needed. Thanks!

reviews.author: Kathryn Byers
reviews.text: The owners of this company was very sweet, as well as their son and friends with helping get my car started, as well as addressing the issue in a very swift fast amount of time. Thank you all!

reviews.author: Jamie Scott
reviews.text: Shout out to T&J towing They arrived quickly, communicated clearly, and handled my vehicle with professionalism and care. The timing was incredibly efficient far faster than I expected and the entire process was smooth and stress-free. I’m truly impressed with their reliability and customer service. Highly recommend T&J Towing for anyone in need of fast, friendly, and dependable towing! They make a great team thank you guys !

reviews.author: Eddie Clarke
reviews.text: T &J towed my vehicle after it was involved in an accident. They were very professional and easy to work with. They insured that my wife and I had access to retrieve items from the vehicle while it was stored at their secured lot.

reviews.author: Allyson Keel
reviews.text: very reliable company they were quick and fast to the scene.I would definitely recommend this towing company great service!

reviews.author: shyasia watts
reviews.text: These people are very rude all the women that work there got smart with me over the phone refused to give me any information but threaten to take me to court ??? Every body that has been towed by these people say they are nasty one lady laughed when I asked her about my car …mind you I was just otp with one of y’all and I asked about any documentation and you said you couldn’t give me the information thinking it’s funny but it’s ok I’ll see yall in court you didn’t have none of that to say over the phone

reviews.author: Josh Jarvis
reviews.text: Pleasure doing business with T&J Towing. When you need a tow, obviously it’s not the best day, right? The way I was treated, response time, and care taken to ensure my vehicle was okay is unmatched. I would recommend T&J to anyone who’s in need of towing. In a busy world, it’s nice to have a business show that they go above and beyond. I’d give a sixth star if it was available.

reviews.author: Paul Phinney
reviews.text: Fast, professional service when you need it most! I had just gotten on 95 when a belt snapped and every light came on. I was able to safely pull onto the shoulder and my first call was T&J. They were on the scene within 10 minutes and had the skill and equipment to safely load my van. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Briana Rose
reviews.text: Quick fast and reliable very glad that I used this company! Great communication thank you for everything

reviews.author: Jami Benham
reviews.text: Chris showed up within less than an hour. He helped get our family and vehicle safely off the highway and to the dealership. Very kind. I really appreciated the communication before and during our tow service. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Rick Brumback
reviews.text: On vacation and had a drive shaft issue Called at 3:00 am,40 minutes later they showed up, loaded my truck and took me to their shop and repaired my problem. Highly recommend these folks.Very professional and courteous. Great employees.

reviews.author: Kenneth Long
reviews.text: Thank you T&J, they were quick to pick up my motorcycle that was broke down and get it to the dealership without delay. Reasonably priced, very professional and took good care of my bike without a scratch. I definitely recommend them for all of your towing needs.

reviews.author: Emily Clarke
reviews.text: This company was fantastic to work with during a difficult time. I very much so appreciated their professionalism and compassion within their customer service. I can’t recommend them enough!

reviews.author: Brandon Mayhew
reviews.text: I am the Property Manager of the Ashland Office & Mini Storage and the Airpark Mini Storage. I use T&J Towing for EVERYTHING towing related! Not only are they amazing to deal with for my business needs but personally for me as well! I've personally called before at 11pm stranded in Richmond, and our vehicle was on a tow truck by 11:45pm! Highly recommend them to other businesses for any towing needs. Thank you for all you do!

reviews.author: Mike Barry
reviews.text: Fast and professional service, A+ Highly recommend, Card is in my wallet, business link is in my phone.

reviews.author: Tiffanie Cantrell
reviews.text: Wonderful company! Comes right out when called. Drivers and owners are always kind and caring. Will always call t&j 1st if I'm ever needed a tow and will recommend them to anyone!

reviews.author: Gail Short
reviews.text: T & J was recommended to me by a friend when I needed a tow for my daughter's car. They were reliable, helpful, attentive, and easy to work with. The next day, my other daughter also needed her car towed and T&J was there to take care of us. They are the bomb diggity and will be my suggestion for anyone who needs their service. We found our go to company! Thanks for taking such excellent care of us!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Lauck
reviews.text: Great customer service!! And awesome pricing. They made a really stressful time for me be a time of ease and comfort. I would use them again any time I needed a tow.

reviews.author: Galaxyaboveme
reviews.text: Couldn't thank you guys enough for being so patient with a gal who has no clue when it comes to vehicles!! Thank you for the fast response!!! And thank you for being so polite!!!! Will definitely recommend you to everyone I know!!!:)

reviews.author: david lenz
reviews.text: I don't often use towing service however, AUSTIN who came to save me on Wednesday is an asset to your service - 6 stars. Arrived as soon as time allowed. Delivered the vehicle according to my instructions. State Farm is correct to assign T & J Towing as their vendor of choice. Stellar service! Thank you, Austin - David L.

reviews.author: Gabrielle Glover
reviews.text: I was stuck on the highway for about 5 hours on July 4th. Due to some miscommunication and high pay rates with my insurance company I elected to have my car towed the max free distance. However, the boss of this company(wish I knew his name In terrible with names!) was a very nice gentleman and he was very knowledgeable and was able to get myself and my vehicle home safe and sound and in record time. I hope to never need a tow truck again, but if I did I’d call him first!

reviews.author: Gary Chenault
reviews.text: Amazing company. The customer service received was the best I have ever received. They exemplify the core values of customer service. They were polite, friendly and knowledgeable. T&J Towing is a must have phone number for those unforseen times.

reviews.author: dakota jester
reviews.text: T&J towing is a very reliable company. They offer many services to fulfill all needs. Very trustworthy and loyal company! Compatible prices and great communication. Hit up T&J for all your towing and recovery needs.

reviews.author: Cody Seymour
reviews.text: I called the owner and he said he could get to me in 45 minutes. He showed up in maybe 25-30 minutes and got me wenched out in a good timely manner! Great service and saved a bunch of money!!

reviews.author: Imani Dennis
reviews.text: I got locked out of my car and Austin was a great help. He was so kind and personable which made me feel good during the situation I was in. He came fast and the service was quick!

reviews.author: Jennifer Clarke
reviews.text: What a wonderful company! They are always there to help. They are family ran and operated. Always a pleasure to work with.

reviews.author: Sam Jetton
reviews.text: Incredible service and communication! The prices are fantastic as well. I’ve never been more pleased while dealing with the stressful situation of needing a tow. They make the process easy and pain free!

reviews.author: Harley Rhodes
reviews.text: T and J towing is very fast and reliable service that my sister and I both trust for any situations we get into on the roads. Just this week I was out doordashing and hit something in the road and blew a tire without any jack or tools with me and within 15 minutes of calling T and J I was being helped off the side of the road. If you’re ever in need of help from a towing company t and j is the way to go!

reviews.author: Adam Harding
reviews.text: Very quickly responded and helped with getting the van transported. Also they offered the best price I could find locally. Thank you!

reviews.author: Brandi Bovell
reviews.text: I will sing their praises to the rooftop. My armada broke down and i asked for a reccomendation on facebook. They were prompt, polite and affordable. When they showed up onsight, apparently the issue was an easy fix, and the owner fixed it onsight. Refused to take any money. And bonus points, she did not make me feel dumb for the silly reason it would not start. Go support this female owned biz. Thanks Jess!

reviews.author: Keion Farrar
reviews.text: My girlfriend got locked out of her car. Austin came in a jiff, and got the door unlocked within seconds! Great people super friendly and quick!

reviews.author: KEVIN GUY
reviews.text: Dealt with T&J towing the other day and he did an excellent job, Top-notch professional towing service!

reviews.author: Karen Kuske
reviews.text: This is the worst towing company I have ever dealt with. The owner is very rude and not helpful at all. Over priced and very hateful person to talk to. Not very understanding or could care less.

reviews.author: SalihIbn
reviews.text: The worst customer service I’ve ever dealt with. The woman Jessica was very rude and denied me access to my vehicle to prove ownership to delay process and charge me more in the end… Horrible Company!!!! Legal action will follow!!!

reviews.author: Codie Heilig
reviews.text: Love this company. They are always professional, on time, and helpful all the way around. I would recommend this company to any of my friends or family!

reviews.author: Sandi Brann
reviews.text: T and J towing is very reliable and reasonable, good people! They put their everything into their business! Thanks for everything!

reviews.author: Jennifer Nye
reviews.text: They were very quick getting there!!!!!!! Customer service was awesome and the driver was so nice and polite!!! Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Cole Sylvia
reviews.text: Great people who always come through in any situation and give great pricing. 5/5!!! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Edward Brann
reviews.text: Great towing company, very respectful, curious, only towing company I use! Thanks Travis and Tereall.

reviews.author: Morgan Smart
reviews.text: T&J was such a big help after our car accident making things quick, easy and affordable! Great customer service very responsive!!
